Lena (Partnerships): Hey team, kicking off the EdgeCase Labs hardware preview program. NDA signed, lab slot confirmed for next Tue. Main goals: validate thermals under our quantized xformer, collect perf/latency, and finalize marketplace packaging.

Omar (Eng-ML): Thanks — can you share the test harness we should run? I want to ensure we exercise KV cache and streaming.

Lena (Partnerships): Yep, link in the doc: https://redwood.internal/edgecase-preview/testplan (internal). Short version below.

Marcus (Runtime): Quick note: EdgeCase runs on their new E7 boards, power limit default is 250W. We should submit a power/profile matrix so we don't hit thermal throttles.

Jia (Solutions): From customer side, typical seq-lens are 64/512. We'll run three workloads: 1) short chat (64), 2) doc-summarization (512), 3) long context retrieval (2048).

Omar (Eng-ML): Got it. Proposed test script (run on their lab node):
```bash
# run perf harness
python run_bench.py --model redwood-v1-q4_0 --batch-sizes 1,4,8 --seq 64,512,2048 --measure latency,throughput,mem
```
We'll also capture per-token latency histogram.

Eva (HW Partner - EdgeCase): Appreciate the heads up. Lab engineer will set up ambient at 22C and capture inlet/outlet thermals. We can stream telemetry to your s3 via secure token. Note: on-prem firewall needs the allowlist 10.45.3.0/24.

Lena (Partnerships): NDA embargo date = 2026-05-10. No public numbers before then. Marketing/PR alignment needed for any benchmark figures. @Jia please own messaging.

Jia (Solutions): Will draft a short joint announcement template and a safe-language benchmark blurb. I’ll share by Fri EOD.

Marcus (Runtime): Two caveats: 1) quantized kernels show small perf regressions at seq=2048; need to ensure fallback to fp16 path is tested. 2) KV cache warmup behavior must be captured (first tokens slow). We'll add a warmup run 10 iterations before measuring.

Omar (Eng-ML): Also add model variant fallback plan in case OOMs: `redwood-v1-q4_0 -> redwood-v1-q8_0 -> redwood-v1-fp16`. Log which variant served each request.

ci-bot: New artifact built: redis/bench-harness:2026-04-07. Triggered by @Omar.

Lena (Partnerships): Action items:
- Omar: finalize bench script + upload to EdgeCase by Mon 10am (owner).
- Marcus: prepare kernel fallback config + monitoring hooks by Mon EOD.
- Jia: draft joint messaging + embargo language by Fri.
- Eva: confirm lab IP allowlist and telemetry endpoint by EOD today.

Eva (HW Partner - EdgeCase): Confirmed. Lab has the allowlist and will provision telemetry token.

Omar (Eng-ML): I'll push the harness and a small sample workload to the shared bucket: s3://redwood-edgecase-preview/harness.tar.gz.

Lena (Partnerships): Great. We'll sync Wednesday 9am PT for a pre-run checklist. If anything blocks earlier, ping here or DM. :thumbsup:
